Lakefront in Seagrove!

200 steps to One Seagrove Beach Access

Eastern Lake!

Outdoor shower

Six-seater golf cart

2 bikes!

Gas and charcoal grills

4-star restaurants

A Hasty Retreat by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to A Hasty Retreat, a spacious and soothing cottage just 200 steps from the beach! The wonderful house overlooks Eastern Lake and rests next to the oldest and largest stand of magnolia trees in the area. The rare, pristine dune lake connects to the Gulf! Paddleboard from the dock directly to the white sandy beach. Or fish, boat, or swim. This is truly a unique 30A gem.

The cottage offers a breathtaking view of sunrise on the lake, where the shallow waters invite kids of all ages to swim, play, and paddle. Newly renovated, A Hasty Retreat features an updated kitchen with an open living and dining area, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, all with a modern, lush, whimsical vibe. The upstairs bedroom has an outstanding view. See the pics! The retreat has three decks – one with a lake and Gulf view, perfect for sunbathing, al fresco dining, and stunning vistas of moonlight on the lake. The lower patio deck offers a lake view with a picnic table and swing, excellent for a nap or relaxing with a good book. The third deck is a great place to enjoy the shade of the beautiful magnolia trees. Oh! Almost forgot about the complimentary golf cart and two bicycles! It doesn’t get much better than this. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 200 steps (0.1 miles) to the beach (Eastern Lake Access) In the event of a high outflow at the Eastern Lake access point, please use the Ramsgate access to the west. - 3 bedrooms, 2 baths - 1365 sq ft - Charcoal grill - Propane grill - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included - Parking for 4 vehicles - Complimentary 6-seater golf cart included - Kayaks not included for guest use Overnight: - King in 1st floor guest room; private bath; TV - King in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV - Queen daybed w/pullout twin trundle ; shared bath; TV - Twin ottoman in 1st floor great room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
